title: Manga Just Buried Superhero Comics In America
source: US print graphic-novel unit sales compiled from NPD BookScan data as reported by ICv2, Comics Beat and Anime News Network: the manga category grew from low single-digit millions of units in the late 2010s to roughly 9 million in 2020 and 24.4 million in 2021 (up over 160% in one year, driven by the anime-streaming boom), while adult superhero graphic novels stayed roughly flat in the high single-digit millions over the same span.
